item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=longitudinal+impact+of+AI-driven+decision+support+systems+on+user+autonomy+and+self-regulation+skills&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1016/j.dss.2026.114720\", \"title\": [\"Corrigendum to ‘Designing AI-driven augmented living spaces with spatial augmented reality to support the autonomy of individuals with amnestic mild cognitive impairment’ [Decision support systems (2026) 114652]\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dss.2026.114720\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026, 10]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.6928898\", \"title\": [\"AI-Driven Healthcare Visualization and Its Impact on Clinical Decision Support Systems\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>AI-driven healthcare visualization is emerging as a critical advancement in modern medical informatics, significantly enhancing the capabilities of Clinical Decision Support Systems (CDSS). By transforming large-scale and complex clinical datasets into interpretable visual formats, such as imaging overlays, predictive dashboards, and interactive diagnostic charts, these systems improve the accuracy, speed, and reliability of clinical decision-making. Integrating machine learning and data visualization techniques, AI enables healthcare professionals to identify patterns, detect anomalies, and assess patient risks more effectively across diverse medical domains, including radiology, cardiology, and chronic disease management. Despite these advantages, challenges such as data privacy concerns, model interpretability limitations, algorithmic bias, and integration difficulties with existing healthcare infrastructure continue to hinder widespread adoption. This paper examines the role of AI-driven visualization in strengthening Clinical Decision Support Systems, highlighting its contributions to diagnostic improvement, workflow optimization, and patient care enhancement, while also addressing its ethical, technical, and operational constraints.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.6928898\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1016/j.dss.2024.114193\", \"title\": [\"Navigating autonomy and control in human-AI delegation: User responses to technology- versus user-invoked task allocation\"], \"URL…
